name: GoFr
description: Documentation and agent resources for GoFr, an opinionated Go framework for production microservices with built-in observability, 15+ datasource integrations, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSockets, Pub/Sub, and cron jobs.

resources.name: GoFr Documentation Content API
resources.description: Read-only HTTP GET access to every documentation page as Markdown, plus site-wide and per-section indexes.

resources.name: GoFr agent primer
resources.description: Framework conventions, datasource patterns, and per-framework migration mappings for AI coding assistants generating GoFr code.

resources.name: GoFr documentation corpus
resources.description: Every documentation page concatenated into a single Markdown file for long-context ingestion.

resources.name: GoFr docs MCP server
resources.description: Model Context Protocol server exposing GoFr documentation search and retrieval as tools. Runs locally over stdio: `go run gofr.dev/mcp/docs-server@latest`.

authentication.description: All resources are public and unauthenticated. See https://gofr.dev/auth.md.
